findings.title: Caller-authored Facebook currency and basis can enter the trusted view
reproduction_steps: Use isolated Migration 002/003 tables and create a Facebook FETCHED record with no content/hash.
Submit a caller-constructed candidate whose raw value has no currency (or says XYZ), while currency_code is DZD and currency_basis is INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED or SOURCE_CONFIRMED.
Call the public review helper with decision APPROVED and a caller-chosen reviewer label; leave review currency fields unset.
Query trusted_price_evidence for the evidence id.
findings.expected_result: Unknown or contradictory currency/basis remains untrusted unless a separately authorized review records supported evidence.
findings.actual_result: Structured DZD and INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED passed repository validation and the trusted view returned the candidate; contradictory raw XYZ was also accepted as DZD.
findings.disposition: Blocks separate production-migration approval. Establish source-to-extraction provenance and an authorized review boundary, then independently reproduce rejection of these forged fields.

findings.title: Nonnumeric text candidate_amount is accepted as trusted evidence
reproduction_steps: Submit a caller-constructed PriceCandidate with candidate_amount='not-a-number' through append_facebook_price_evidence.
Add an otherwise eligible approved review.
Query candidate_amount and typeof(candidate_amount) from price_evidence and trusted_price_evidence.
findings.expected_result: Malformed amount rejected or excluded from the trusted view.
findings.actual_result: SQLite stored TEXT 'not-a-number' in the REAL-affinity field; the CHECK passed and trusted_price_evidence returned it.
findings.disposition: Blocks separate production-migration approval until runtime and schema/view type enforcement close this case and the focused suite is rerun.

findings.title: Foundation schema validator rejects equivalent identifier casing/quoting
reproduction_steps: Create a valid isolated Foundation 001 schema and remove schema_migrations to model an untracked existing schema.
Rename products through a temporary name to PRODUCTS.
Inspect Foundation state.
findings.expected_result: Accept the table name as equivalent under SQLite ASCII identifier rules, or clearly constrain the supported schema dialect.
findings.actual_result: Validator reports PARTIAL; equivalent quoted/unquoted spellings also canonicalize differently in the tokenizer.
findings.disposition: Fix or constrain/document before applying the validator to broad legacy-schema baselining; no data was changed.

findings.title: Restore staged-verification exception leaves a full temporary database copy
reproduction_steps: Create a signed isolated backup and target.
Inject an exception from verify_backup(stage), after the backup is copied but before target replacement.
Inspect the target hash and target directory.
findings.expected_result: Target remains intact and stage file is removed on every failure path.
findings.actual_result: Target hash remained unchanged, but .target.sqlite.restore-stage-*.sqlite remained beside it.
findings.disposition: Fix exception-safe stage cleanup before relying on restore operationally; isolated reproduction only.

findings.title: Missing manifest key is regenerated during verification
reproduction_steps: Create a valid isolated signed backup.
Point _manifest_key_path at a missing temporary path and call verify_backup(require_manifest=True).
Inspect the error and temporary key path.
findings.expected_result: Fail closed with explicit key-loss diagnosis without treating a new key as the original.
findings.actual_result: A replacement 32-byte key was created, then verification failed with a generic signature-invalid error; the backup was not accepted.
findings.disposition: Operational limitation; recover original key or follow documented manual recovery. Improve diagnostics and avoid replacement-key creation during verification.
